title: {run}-evolve-plan.json
description: Output of evolve.md task 5 (proposal composition). Set of mutation ops chosen at the audit gate. Consumed by evolve.md task 6 (apply). See skills/admin-apex/SKILL.md task 5/6.

run.description: 8-char lowercase hex run token (mints in SKILL task 1).

kind.description: create=new file (skill/agent/script/schema). rename=path change (mirror update of refs). split=one file -> N files. merge=N files -> one. retire=delete + ref removal. schema-add/remove=schemas/*.json add or delete. hook-add/remove=settings.json hook entry add/remove.

target.description: Primary path (existing for rename/split/merge/retire/schema-remove/hook-remove; new for create/schema-add/hook-add).

split_into.description: Required for kind=split: list of new files derived from target.

merge_sources.description: Required for kind=merge: list of files merged into target.

rationale.description: One-line audit-cluster reason this op was chosen.

doc_only.description: True if op only edits spec docs (README/apex-core/overview/CLAUDE.md) without structural mutation. Drives task 9 patch-vs-minor bump.

source_clusters.description: Drift-report cluster ids that motivated each op (for audit trail).
